1.consolidated_definition: Juego en que dos jugadores se arrojan mutuamente la pelota, evitando que un tercero, que está en el medio, pueda atraparla.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Game in which two players toss the ball back and forth to each other, avoiding a third player who is positioned in between them.
